text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Arima Kinen on the horizon,<n>Rice Shower is
asked to take part in a<n>joint interview.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-huh?! I'm going to be in the<n>middle?

You won the popularity poll! Of course<n>a star like
you would be in the middle!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but... but today—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice. Please make your responses<n>quick and crisp.
There is another<n>interview after the photoshoot as
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's right. It wouldn't do to<n>start without
the star.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe you also plan to<n>announce you will
"run the ultimate<n>race," correct?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My! Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I look forward to seeing such<n>a sight.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, no... Everyone looks so scary...
choice_data_list: Being the star is hard, huh?
Being the star is hard, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Aughhh... Not you too, Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Aughhh... Not you too, Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, the interview concludes. As<n>a reward and
to blow off some<n>steam, Rice Shower and I head
out<n>into town.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Phew... I was so nervous.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... I can't believe they put me<n>in the center
between those two.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If you had told me three years ago<n>that would
happen, I would have<n>assumed you were telling me
about a<n>dream.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I can hardly believe it myself.<n>It's like a
magical holiday miracle...
choice_data_list: Maybe it's your present from Santa this year.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, no, I think you're the one who<n>performed
this miracle.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, no, I think you're the one who<n>performed
this miracle.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though I've messed up so<n>much, you've
always stayed with<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're the reason I've come this far.<n>I couldn't
have made such<n>miraculous progress... without you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hey, what kind of present do you<n>want?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hey, what kind of present do you<n>want?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're always giving me gifts, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to return the favor, even if it's<n>just
something small.
choice_data_list: I want to see you giving it your all.
I want to see you giving it your all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...That's it? You don't want anything<n>else?
choice_data_list: Couldn't think of a better present if I tried!
Couldn't think of a better present if I tried!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I'll work as hard as I can.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you smile, but not just for<n>the holidays!
I'll keep you happy<n>forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you smile, but not just for<n>the holidays!
I'll keep you happy<n>forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you my best running and<n>make you super
happy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Great!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...No way! That's not enough!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was going to work hard even if you<n>didn't ask me
to! So...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna work harder than hard to<n>get you the
best present of all... First<n>place at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's a present that only I can give<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! Now you've got<n>another reason
to look forward to this<n>year's Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
What was supposed to be a chance<n>to take a break
has become a very<n>invigorating holiday.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you for today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you for today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Once the Arima Kinen is here, I'm<n>going to make
you happy, along with<n>everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Once the Arima Kinen is here, I'm<n>going to make
you happy, along with<n>everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Having declared that, Rice Shower<n>runs off with a
skip in her step.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's so much more resolute now<n>than she was
when we first met. It<n>looks like this time I'm the
one who'll<n>have to catch up to her.
